open.speaker: saoirse
open.text: Thanks for stopping to help us.

dialogue.speaker: saoirse
dialogue.text: It's probably better if you drop me off here.

choices.label: I see... Not how you remembered me, huh?
It's a long way to the hotel.

ian-echo-look.speaker: ian
ian-echo-look.text: Right. Not how you remembered me, huh? Go ahead, tell me I look like shit. At least we'd be clear on one thing.

ian-echo-hotel.speaker: ian
ian-echo-hotel.text: The hotel's still a long way off. You'll be soaked before you're halfway there.

dialogue-1-bitter-2.speaker: saoirse
dialogue-1-bitter-2.text: I'm sorry you had to see me again, Ian. I promise you never will.

note.text: Her hand is already on the door handle.

choices.label: There's something you need to know. Whatever killed Caleb and the others ten years ago... it's back in Mag Point.
It's about your dad, Saoirse. He's been arrested.

ian-echo-truth-bitter.speaker: ian
ian-echo-truth-bitter.text: Saoirse, I don't know why you came back, and I'm not going to ask. But there's something you need to know. Whatever killed Caleb and the others ten years ago... it's back in Mag Point.

ian-echo-dad-soft.speaker: ian
ian-echo-dad-soft.text: I didn't mean to be rude. But there's something you should hear. It's about your dad. Val's been arrested.

dialogue-2-reasonable-1.speaker: saoirse
dialogue-2-reasonable-1.text: It's okay. I'll catch a ride.

choices.label: Don't be silly. I'll drive you.
Something's happened. You need to hear it.

ian-echo-drive.speaker: ian
ian-echo-drive.text: Don't be silly, Saoirse. You know you won't. I'll get you to the hotel.

ian-echo-pretend.speaker: ian
ian-echo-pretend.text: You can stop pretending. Anything, just not to spend a minute with me, right?

ian-echo-happened.speaker: ian
ian-echo-happened.text: Look, I get it. You don't want to be here one second longer than you have to. But something's happened, and you need to know about it.

dialogue-2-reasonable-2.speaker: saoirse
dialogue-2-reasonable-2.text: Thanks... I'm sorry you had to see me again. I promise you never will again

choices.label: Wait. There's something you need to know.
There's something you need to know. Whatever killed Caleb and the others ten years ago... it's back in Mag Point.
I need your help, Saoirse.
choices.lockedLabel: locked — she won't hear this from you now

ian-echo-truth.speaker: ian
ian-echo-truth.text: Saoirse, I don't know why you came back, and I'm not going to ask. But there's something you need to know. Whatever killed Caleb and the others ten years ago... it's back in Mag Point.

ian-echo-dad.speaker: ian
ian-echo-dad.text: It's about your dad. Val's been arrested.

ian-echo-help.speaker: ian
ian-echo-help.text: I know how strange that sounds... but I need your help, Saoirse.

choices.label: There's something you need to know. Whatever killed Caleb and the others ten years ago... it's back in Mag Point.
Sorry. *Flick the cigarette out the window.*

ian-echo-know.speaker: ian
ian-echo-know.text: There's a lot I never used to do. But how would you know — you of all people?

dialogue-3-smoke-2.speaker: saoirse
dialogue-3-smoke-2.text: Listen, I'm sorry you had to see me again, Ian. I didn't want that. Can you stop the car and let me out?

choices.label: Wait. There's something you need to know.

end_act_no_talk.speaker: saoirse
end_act_no_talk.text: *She walks away from the car. Ian watches her go.*

outcome.title: You didn't tell her
outcome.blurb: Saoirse will remember that you let her walk into it blind. Later, she won't believe Ian when he tells the truth.

end_act_saoirse_reaction_1.speaker: saoirse
end_act_saoirse_reaction_1.text: Shut up. Shut up. Shut up! Don't you dare say it. You came up with this just now? Go to hell, Ian!

variants.text: Shut up. Shut up. SHUT UP! Don't you dare say his name. You... You... Look at you, freak! You came up with this just now? Fuck you! I hate you! Rot, you bastard!

outcome.title: Saoirse is shocked
outcome.blurb: She'll regret the things she said. Later, remorse will bring her back to help Ian.

end_act_saoirse_reaction_2.speaker: saoirse
end_act_saoirse_reaction_2.text: My father is under arrest? Why? What happened?

outcome.title: To the precinct
outcome.blurb: Saoirse asks you to drive her to the Mag Point Police Department. Later, she will help Ian in his investigation.

end_act_help_refused.speaker: saoirse
end_act_help_refused.text: Whatever it is you need, Ian — I can't help you. I'm sorry we met again. Please don't try to find me before I leave for good.

outcome.title: She turns you down
outcome.blurb: You asked without armor, and she still said no. Later, she will help Ian when times comes.
